name: Success and Failure
blurb: Nỗ lực, thành tựu, vấp ngã

words.definitionEn: a thing that blocks one's way or prevents progress
words.example: Lack of funding is a major obstacle to the project's completion.

words.definitionEn: severe suffering or privation
words.example: Many entrepreneurs overcome financial hardship before achieving success.

words.definitionEn: lack of success in achieving a goal
words.example: Failure is often a stepping stone to future accomplishments.

words.definitionEn: to successfully reach a desired objective or result
words.example: She worked tirelessly to achieve her dream of becoming a doctor.

words.definitionEn: to successfully deal with a problem or difficulty
words.example: They managed to overcome every setback during the campaign.

words.definitionEn: an attempt to achieve something, especially a difficult one
words.example: His latest endeavor in renewable energy has attracted global attention.

words.definitionEn: a reversal or check in progress
words.example: The team suffered a major setback when their funding was cut.

words.meaningVi: cột mốc, thành tựu quan trọng
words.definitionEn: an important event or stage in development
words.example: Graduating from university is a significant milestone in one's life.

words.definitionEn: something that has been achieved successfully
words.example: Winning the award was the greatest accomplishment of her career.

words.definitionEn: a strong desire to achieve something high or great
words.example: Many young people have aspirations to become leaders in their fields.

words.definitionEn: to succeed in achieving something after effort
words.example: Only a few climbers manage to attain the summit of Everest.

words.definitionEn: to do or be better than something or someone
words.example: Her sales figures have surpassed all previous records.

words.meaningVi: phát triển mạnh mẽ, thịnh vượng
words.definitionEn: to grow or develop in a healthy or vigorous way
words.example: The business began to flourish after the new marketing strategy was implemented.

words.definitionEn: persistence in doing something despite difficulty or delay
words.example: Perseverance is often the key to turning failure into success.

words.meaningVi: sự kiên cường, khả năng phục hồi
words.definitionEn: the capacity to recover quickly from difficulties
words.example: Her resilience in the face of adversity inspired everyone around her.

words.meaningVi: thắng lợi lớn, thành công rực rỡ
words.definitionEn: a great victory or achievement
words.example: The team's triumph in the championship was celebrated nationwide.

words.meaningVi: sự sụp đổ, nguyên nhân thất bại
words.definitionEn: a loss of power, status, or prosperity; a cause of failure
words.example: Arrogance was the downfall of many once-successful leaders.

words.meaningVi: đột phá, bước tiến quan trọng
words.definitionEn: a sudden, important advance or discovery
words.example: The development of the vaccine was a major breakthrough in medical science.

words.definitionEn: the most successful point of something
words.example: Winning an Olympic gold medal is often considered the pinnacle of an athlete's career.

words.definitionEn: a difficult or unpleasant situation
words.example: Success is often sweeter when achieved after overcoming adversity.

words.meaningVi: chùn bước, nao núng, suy yếu
words.definitionEn: to lose strength or momentum; to hesitate
words.example: His confidence began to falter after repeated rejections.

words.definitionEn: enthusiastic and public praise
words.example: The novel received widespread critical acclaim after its publication.

words.definitionEn: an award or privilege granted as a special honor
words.example: The Nobel Prize is one of the highest accolades a scientist can receive.

words.meaningVi: sự kiên cường, bền bỉ không lùi bước
words.definitionEn: the quality of being very determined and persistent
words.example: Her tenacity in pursuing her goals eventually led to a breakthrough.

words.definitionEn: a sudden and ignominious failure; a fiasco
words.example: The product launch turned into a complete debacle due to poor planning.

words.definitionEn: the physical or mental energy needed to do something
words.example: She put tremendous effort into her research.

words.definitionEn: the accomplishment of an aim or purpose
words.example: His success was the result of years of hard work.

words.definitionEn: an act of defeating an opponent
words.example: The team celebrated their victory.

words.definitionEn: the state of being beaten
words.example: They suffered a crushing defeat.

words.definitionEn: a task or situation that tests one's abilities
words.example: This challenge tested our abilities.

words.meaningVi: cuộc đấu tranh, sự khó khăn
words.definitionEn: a forceful or violent effort to get free of restraint
words.example: The struggle for survival is real.

words.definitionEn: an experience that teaches a moral or practical lesson
words.example: Mistakes often teach a valuable lesson.

words.definitionEn: the process of increasing in size or improving
words.example: Personal growth often comes from challenges.

words.definitionEn: forward or onward movement toward a goal
words.example: We have made significant progress.

words.definitionEn: the act of making something better
words.example: There is room for improvement.

words.definitionEn: firmness of purpose
words.example: Her determination never wavered.

words.definitionEn: continued effort to do something despite difficulties
words.example: Persistence is key to success.

words.definitionEn: the quality of being committed to a task
words.example: His dedication to the project was admirable.

words.definitionEn: the ability to sustain prolonged physical or mental effort
words.example: Running a marathon requires great stamina.

words.definitionEn: careful and persistent work or effort
words.example: Diligence is essential for academic success.

words.definitionEn: an obstacle or difficulty
words.example: The first hurdle was securing funding.

words.definitionEn: a circumstance that obstructs progress
words.example: Language can be a barrier to communication.

words.definitionEn: the feeling of being upset or annoyed
words.example: Her frustration grew with each unsuccessful attempt.

words.definitionEn: acknowledgment of someone's work or achievements
words.example: She received recognition for her efforts.

words.definitionEn: fame and honor won by great achievements
words.example: He sought glory on the battlefield.

words.definitionEn: to make great efforts to achieve something
words.example: We must strive for excellence.

words.definitionEn: courage and resolve; strength of character
words.example: She showed true grit in the face of difficulties.

words.definitionEn: widespread respect and admiration
words.example: The university has great prestige.

words.definitionEn: the act of gaining control over something
words.example: The conquest of the mountain was a feat.

words.definitionEn: a position of dominant power or influence
words.example: The company gained ascendancy over its rivals.
